name: Transaction Return Criteria 5
definition: Defines the criteria used to report on a payment transaction.

PaymentToReturnCriteria.name: Payment To Return Criteria
PaymentToReturnCriteria.definition: Destination of the payment (be it a member or a system or both).

PaymentFromReturnCriteria.name: Payment From Return Criteria
PaymentFromReturnCriteria.definition: Origin of the payment (be it a member or a system or both).

AccountCashEntryReturnCriteria.name: Account Cash Entry Return Criteria
AccountCashEntryReturnCriteria.definition: Defines the criteria used to report on the cash entry.

PaymentReturnCriteria.name: Payment Return Criteria
PaymentReturnCriteria.definition: Defines the criteria used to report on the payment.
